analysis: The method storeGroup receives an MsnGroup object and calls msnGroups.put with key from getGroupName() and value the object itself. There are no null checks before the call. The put method throws NullPointerException if key or value is null. The key could be null if getGroupName() returns null, and the value could be null if msnGroup is null. Since there are no validations, the NullPointerException is not avoided.
remark: NullPointerException can be triggered if msnGroup is null (causing NPE when calling getGroupName() before put), or if msnGroup.getGroupName() returns null (causing NPE inside put). Also if msnGroup is non-null but getGroupName() returns null, put will throw NPE. No checks are present to prevent these.
